tok 1.0 "Character generator"

pool blizzard "Blizzard online character generator"
  lane player "Player"
    start begin "Character creation started"
    and split
    task names "Come up with character names"
    task checkacc "Check for battle.net account"
    xor hasacc "Battle.net account?"
    task info "Enter the account information"
    task link "Click the link in the confirmation mail"
    xor accmerge
    task checksub "Check for active WoW subscription"
    xor hassub "Active subscription?"
    task pay "Select the payment method"
    xor method "Payment method?"
    task card "Enter the credit card information"
    task iban "Enter the IBAN and BIC numbers"
    xor paymerge
    xor submerge
    task login "Log into the game"
    task select "Select realm, race and class"
    and join
    task entername "Enter a name"
    xor avail "Name available?"
  lane system "System"
    task confirm "Send confirmation and selfies"
    end done "Character created"

flow begin -> split
flow split -> names
flow split -> checkacc
flow checkacc -> hasacc
flow hasacc -> info "no"
flow hasacc -> accmerge "yes"
flow info -> link -> accmerge
flow accmerge -> checksub -> hassub
flow hassub -> pay "no"
flow hassub -> submerge "yes"
flow pay -> method
flow method -> card "credit card"
flow method -> iban "bank account"
flow card -> paymerge
flow iban -> paymerge
flow paymerge -> submerge
flow submerge -> login -> select -> join
flow names -> join
flow join -> entername -> avail
flow avail -> confirm "yes"
flow avail -> entername "no"
flow confirm -> done
